types.explanation: Initiates a session (dialog) and establishes an offer/answer exchange. The fundamental method for session establishment.
Confirms receipt of a final response to an INVITE. Used for reliability of INVITE transactions.
Terminates an established session and its associated dialog.
Cancels a previous request that has not yet received a final response, typically an INVITE.
Queries a server or UA for its capabilities (e.g., supported methods, content types).
Registers a binding between an address-of-record and one or more contact addresses into a location service.
Carries application-level information within an existing dialog. May be associated with an Info Package (requires Info-Package header) or used in legacy mode.
Provisional Response ACKnowledgment. Provides reliability for provisional responses (1xx) to INVITE, used with option tag 100rel.
Requests current state and state updates from a notifier for a specific event package (identified by the Event header field).
Informs subscribers of changes in state for a resource to which they have an active subscription (Event header field must match the subscription).
Requests that the recipient contact a third party using the URI in the Refer-To header field. Creates an implicit subscription to the 'refer' event.
Updates parameters of a session (e.g., media streams) without affecting the dialog state. Can be sent in early or confirmed dialogs.
Publishes event state to an Event State Compositor. Used for event packages (e.g., presence) and includes the Event header field.
Transfers an instant message (pager-style). Does not establish a dialog; may be sent within or outside a dialog.
